name: Hytale
tagline: One Java plugin for Hytale dedicated servers that connects to Takaro itself, no sidecar.
requirements: Hytale dedicated server (the version named in the file name)
File access to the server's mods folder

assets.label: Server plugin
assets.hint: Copy into <server>/mods/, start the server once, then set REGISTRATION_TOKEN in mods/HytaleTakaroMod/TakaroConfig.properties and restart.
